_about.note: Committed metrics for the capture-spacing study. The Mapillary census CSVs stay in the gitignored /experiments/pano-spacing/ (pulled from prod; any run from 2026-07-23 carries the extras columns); this file is the durable record of the derived numbers the writeup cites. distributions[] carries 0.5 m histograms so the figures are reproducible without the census, and spacing_shares() recomputes every share the writeup quotes from those bins.
